notes.title: Twitch Plays Chess: GM Popilski Live from PAX South
notes.notes:
Join us on Sunday 29th January at 3.30pm CST / 9.30 pm GMT as we host the first ever Twitch Plays Chess event for a live audience!

We're taking over the Falcon Theatre at PAX South and inviting the audience to play live against chess Grandmaster Gil Popilski! Viewers on Twitch will also be able to take part by joining the official PAX Twitch chat.

Get involved and make your move: [url=twitch.tv/pax2] WATCH THE STREAM[/url]

Vote for chess moves in the Twitch chat (eg. D2 D4) to see if the collective mind of Twitch can beat a chess GM with an ELO ranking of 2551!

notes.title: Twitch Plays Pure Chess with IM Daniel Rensch (VP @ Chess.com)
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone!

And what a way to start the new year, with a brand new Twitch Plays Chess event! Join us on Monday to play Pure Chess live against International Master Daniel Rensch for a chance to win free games. Now that's a Monday evening offer you can't refuse..

IM Rensch will be taking on the hive mind of our [url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]Twitch channel[/url] on Monday 9th January from 5pm GMT / 9am PST, so come and make your best move. Vote for the move you want to see the chat make and then the most popular move will happen.

PLUS If you all manage to beat IM Rensch, everyone watching will win a free Ripstone game. 

If you have any questions for IM Rensch, leave them in the comments and we will ask them live on stream. Hope to see some of you making your best move in the chat on Monday!

[url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]WATCH THE STREAM[/url]

notes.title: Steampunk Chess Set: Available Now
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

The first DLC chess set and environment for Pure Chess Grandmaster Edition launched today! 

We're really excited for you to be able to bring some splendour to the chess board with the new Steampunk chess set. The set also includes a brand new environment, transporting the chessboard inside a steampunk zeppelin inspired by Victorian era science fiction.

url=store.steampowered.com/app/330950/?snr=1_5_9__405
The Steampunk set is available now, priced at £1.99 / $2.99.

To celebrate the launch of the Steampunk DLC, we are bringing chess to the front page of Twitch today from 4pm GMT / 8am PST. Make the most of the World Chess Championship rest day and join us to play live against Grandmaster Niclas Huschenbeth by voting for chess moves in the Twitch chat!

Make your best move against GM Huschenbeth from 4pm today [url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames] on our Twitch channel.[/url]

notes.title: New DLC Announced: Steampunk Chess Set and Location
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Since the launch of Pure Chess on Steam we have been working behind the scenes to bring some new chess sets and environments to the game. We are now able to share that the first new set to arrive on Steam is the Steampunk chess set!

We're really excited to be bringing this exclusive set to PC and Xbox One and can't wait to see what you think of it. We took inspiration from our steampunk mech-combat game Ironcast to design this stunning set, hoping to bring some splendour to the chess board!

The Steampunk set launches on Wednesday 16th November, priced at £1.99 / $2.99.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/330950/?snr=1_5_9__405]Take a closer look on the Steam Store Page.[/url]

notes.title: Play Live Against a Chess Grandmaster on Wednesday 16th November
notes.notes:
Twitch plays chess is back.

After a crazy reception for the first ever crowdsourced chess game on Twitch, we’re bringing Twitch vs. Pure Chess back with a vengeance.

On Wednesday November 16 from 4pm GMT / 8am PST, Grandmaster Niclas Huschenbeth will be taking on the hive mind of the Twitch chat in a live showdown on [url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames] the Ripstone Twitch channel.[/url] The previous instalment of Twitch plays chess saw over 6000 players voting for moves against GM Simon Willams, with the overall result being two wins for the GM, one win for the chat. Niclas will be battling it out with the chat for a clear run on the front page of Twitch, so the stakes are pretty high.

[url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]Follow us on Twitch	[/url] to be notified when we go live with GM Huschenbeth!

We will be asking Niclas questions throughout the stream, so if there is something you would like us to ask him, please leave a comment below!

If the chat manages to defeat Niclas, everyone watching will be given a free game from the Ripstone catalogue. So join us on the front page of Twitch on November 16th from 4pm GMT and make your best move!

Who wins? Chess decides. (sorry)

notes.title: Update Released Today
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Thank you to everyone that has been in touch since launch, we really appreciate your feedback. We have released an update today to fix some of the issues you have reported, including: 

- Mouse accuracy on various game modes
- Resolution issues have been fixed
- A fix for some players experiencing a crash on game start up. (We are still looking into this issue further and hope to learn more from this update)
- We have also identified a possible fix for some crashes which involves the Steam overlay. Disabling the Steam overlay will resolve some crash issues and you can do this by accessing Steam settings in the top left, choosing ‘In Game’ and de-selecting ‘enable the steam overlay while in game’. 

If you're still having issues with the items detailed above please let us know on the pinned 'Support' post on the community forum, or drop us an email to info@ripstone.com. We are continuing to investigate audio issues and hope to fix this in an update in the near future. 

Also, we are live on Twitch now playing against the chat, so join us to try and beat us at our own game. Literally...

[url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames] Watch the Stream Now[/url]

Thanks
Ripstone

notes.title: Twitch Plays Chess Against A Grandmaster And Wins
notes.notes:
The power of the hive mind shouldn t be a surprise to anyone by now, but for some reason I assumed chess was an exception. When the creators of Pure Chess [official site] decided to promote their new game by pitting the chat stream of Twitch against British grandmaster Simon Williams, I shrugged and thought: well it s nice that they have graduated from Dark Souls and Pokemon – assuming that they would be soundly trounced. The chess champion went on to win the first two games. But during the third, Twitch struck back and won.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Twitch vs. Pure Chess: The Grandmaster Challenge
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

To celebrate the launch of Pure Chess on PC this Friday, we are hosting a Twitch stream with a twist, and a very special guest...

On Friday September 9th, join us on Twitch to take on the ultimate chess challenge: battling a Grandmaster. In this exclusive world-first, viewers on Twitch will vote for moves in the chat as part of a crowdsourced game against Simon Williams, British veteran Grandmaster with a FIDE rating of 2444.

Who will win? Chess decides. (sorry...)

Join us on [url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]our Twitch channel[/url] on September 9th, 8am PST / 4pm BST, and make your move against the GM in a battle to become Pure Chess champion.

We hope to see some of you in the chat to celebrate the launch!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BhURT2eHKYQ]WATCH TWITCH VS. PURE CHESS TRAILER[/url]

notes.title: Pure Chess checks in on September 9th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Before we start talking dates... we firstly want to thank everyone that has reached out to us in the run up to the launch of Pure Chess on Steam. We have had a great response to the initial announcement and can't wait for you to all start playing. We're monitoring the forums daily so you know where to find us if you have any questions or just fancy having a chat about chess!

In even more exciting news! We can now confirm that Pure Chess Grandmaster Edition will be launching onto Steam on Friday September 9th. Just one more week to go! In the mean time, we're running a wishlist competition offering five players a chance to win a copy of the game on launch day. Full details can be found on [url=http://www.ripstone.com/archive.php?year=2016&month=09] our website.[/url]

Happy Friday!
